minemenu.action.arrow_rain.desc: 50 arrows fall from the sky where you're looking.
minemenu.action.auto_sort.desc: Sort your inventory (not the hotbar): stacks merged and ordered by item.
minemenu.action.clear_ground_items.desc: Remove every dropped item and stuck arrow within 64 blocks (handy after explosions).
minemenu.action.clear_junk.desc: Delete junk from your inventory: rotten flesh, poisonous potatoes, spider eyes, dirt, gravel, granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, cobbled deepslate and netherrack. Armor and items you renamed are never touched. Undo Clear brings it all back.
minemenu.action.clear_selection.desc: Empty the selection (set it to air).
minemenu.action.copy.desc: Copy the blocks in the selection (with chests' contents).
minemenu.action.duplicate.desc: Get a copy of the stack in your hand.
minemenu.action.explode.desc: Cause an explosion where you're looking. Turn on God Mode first!
minemenu.action.fill_selection.desc: Fill the selection with the block in your main hand.
minemenu.action.fireball.desc: Shoot an exploding fireball where you're looking.
minemenu.action.go_home.desc: Teleport back to your Home waypoint, even from another dimension.
minemenu.action.grow_plants.desc: Every crop, sapling and plant within 8 blocks grows fully, right now. Saplings become trees!
minemenu.action.kill_all.desc: Kill every mob within 64 blocks (not you, pets or armor stands).
minemenu.action.kill_hostile.desc: Kill every hostile mob within 64 blocks.
minemenu.action.loot_refill.desc: Loot chests within 48 blocks that you already opened get new loot (open them again).
minemenu.action.mark_chest.desc: Look at a chest (or barrel) and mark it, to open it later from anywhere.
minemenu.action.meteor_strike.desc: A meteor falls where you're looking, leaves a crater and ores. Turn on God Mode first!
minemenu.action.mob_rain.desc: 20 random mobs fall from the sky around you. Chaos!
minemenu.action.mob_war.desc: Every hostile mob within 48 blocks starts attacking the others.
minemenu.action.netherite_kit.desc: Get a full set of super-enchanted netherite armor and tools.
minemenu.action.open_crafting.desc: Open a crafting table anywhere (Remote Chest).
minemenu.action.open_enchanting.desc: Open an enchanting table anywhere. No bookshelves around, so the best is level 8 (Remote Chest).
minemenu.action.open_ender_chest.desc: Open your ender chest from anywhere (Remote Chest).
minemenu.action.open_marked_chest.desc: Open the chest you marked, from anywhere in the same dimension (its chunk must be loaded).
minemenu.action.paste_confirm.desc: Place the copy where the preview is. Big copies are built over a few ticks.
minemenu.action.paste_preview.desc: Show where the copy would go: on the block you look at. Look around, then Confirm Paste.
minemenu.action.repair_all.desc: Fully repair every item in your inventory.
minemenu.action.resize_mob.desc: The mob you're looking at becomes giant, then tiny, then normal again. It stays that size.
minemenu.action.ride_mob.desc: Ride the mob you're looking at (up to 32 blocks away). Sneak to get off.
minemenu.action.rotate.desc: Turn the copy a quarter turn clockwise.
minemenu.action.set_corner_1.desc: The block you look at becomes corner 1 of the selection.
minemenu.action.set_corner_2.desc: The block you look at becomes corner 2 of the selection.
minemenu.action.set_home.desc: Remember where you're standing as the waypoint "Home". Saved with the world.
minemenu.action.super_enchant.desc: Put every enchantment that fits on the item in your hand, at max level.
minemenu.action.teleport.desc: Teleport to the block you're looking at.
minemenu.action.tnt_rain.desc: Drop a ring of lit TNT around you. Turn on God Mode first!
minemenu.action.tornado.desc: A tornado appears where you look and pulls mobs and items around for 20 seconds (no blocks broken).
minemenu.action.undo.desc: Undo the last paste, fill, clear, brush or structure (up to 10).
minemenu.action.undo_clear.desc: Get back everything the last Clear Junk removed.
minemenu.action.wolf_army.desc: 5 tamed wolves appear around you and fight for you.
minemenu.creator.look_at_block: Look at a block to spawn the mob there
minemenu.feature.always_crit.desc: Every fully charged hit is a critical hit (+50% damage), no jumping needed.
minemenu.feature.always_day.desc: Stops time at midday and keeps the weather clear.
minemenu.feature.auto_eat.desc: When you get hungry, you eat the best food in your inventory by yourself. Never eats golden apples or bad food.
minemenu.feature.auto_fish.desc: Cast a fishing rod: it reels in by itself when a fish bites, then casts again.
minemenu.feature.auto_replant.desc: Harvest a fully grown crop and it plants itself again (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart).
minemenu.feature.auto_smelt.desc: Blocks you mine drop already smelted: iron, gold and copper ingots, glass, stone and more. Works with Vein Miner.
minemenu.feature.auto_sprint.desc: You always sprint when walking forward.
minemenu.feature.auto_tool.desc: When you start breaking a block, your hotbar switches to the best tool for it.
minemenu.feature.auto_totem.desc: Keeps a Totem of Undying in your off hand: when one is used up, the next one from your inventory takes its place.
minemenu.feature.bow_aimbot.desc: Your arrows curve towards the hostile mob closest to where you aimed.
minemenu.feature.chaos_mode.desc: Something random happens every few minutes: meteors, diamond rain, a mob invasion... (Chaos Events... picks which).
minemenu.feature.chest_esp.desc: Chests, barrels, shulker boxes and ender chests within 32 blocks glow through walls.
minemenu.feature.chunk_borders.desc: Shows the borders of chunks (like F3+G).
minemenu.feature.dash.desc: Press the Dash key (V) for a quick burst in the direction you're moving. Has a short cooldown.
minemenu.feature.death_chest.desc: When you die without Keep Inventory, your items go into a chest where you died, with a waypoint to it.
minemenu.feature.double_jump.desc: Jump again in mid-air (1 to 3 extra jumps, right-click the button to change).
minemenu.feature.elytra_boost.desc: While gliding with an elytra, hold forward to speed up like with endless fireworks.
minemenu.feature.explosive_arrows.desc: Your arrows explode like a creeper when they hit something. They break blocks!
minemenu.feature.fast_breed.desc: Animals around you (16 blocks) can breed again right away, and babies grow up instantly.
minemenu.feature.fast_swim.desc: Swim and walk in water as fast as on land (Dolphin's Grace).
minemenu.feature.feather_fall.desc: Fall slowly and gently, like a feather (Slow Falling).
minemenu.feature.floor_is_lava.desc: Challenge: the blocks you stand on turn into magma. Keep moving!
minemenu.feature.fly.desc: Fly like in creative mode. Double-tap jump to take off.
minemenu.feature.force_field.desc: Hostile mobs get pushed out of a bubble around you (5 blocks by default).
minemenu.feature.freecam.desc: Fly the camera around freely while your body stays where it is. WASD, space and sneak move the camera.
minemenu.feature.freeze_world.desc: Freeze every mob, projectile and machine. You can still move.
minemenu.feature.full_bright.desc: Everything is fully lit, like max gamma: no dark caves or nights, without the Night Vision effect.
minemenu.feature.god_mode.desc: Take no damage, never get hungry, never drown or burn.
minemenu.feature.gravity_control.desc: Change your own gravity from 0.1x (moon) to 3x (right-click the button for the slider).
minemenu.feature.gravity_gun.desc: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to grab a mob or block, again to throw it.
minemenu.feature.growth_aura.desc: Crops, saplings and plants around you (8 blocks) keep growing much faster, like bone meal every second.
minemenu.feature.infinite_durability.des: Your tools, weapons and armor never wear out (stacks still get used up, unlike Infinite Items).
minemenu.feature.infinite_items.desc: The stack in your hands never runs out and your tools never break.
minemenu.feature.info_hud.desc: Coordinates, direction, biome, time, day, speed, chunk and light level on screen.
minemenu.feature.instant_build.desc: No delay between placing blocks: hold right-click to place 20 blocks a second.
minemenu.feature.item_magnet.desc: Dropped items and XP orbs within 12 blocks fly to you.
minemenu.feature.jetpack.desc: Hold jump to fly upwards, no Fly needed. You never take fall damage while it's on.
minemenu.feature.keep_inventory.desc: Keep your items and XP when you die.
minemenu.feature.lava_swim.desc: Swim in lava like in water: no burning, fast movement and a clear view.
minemenu.feature.lifesteal.desc: Heal a part of the damage you deal (25% by default, right-click to change).
minemenu.feature.light_overlay.desc: Marks the blocks around you (16 blocks) where mobs can spawn, in the dark.
minemenu.feature.long_reach.desc: Reach blocks and mobs from much farther away.
minemenu.feature.lucky_blocks.desc: Breaking a sponge gives a random surprise, good or bad.
minemenu.feature.magnet_filter.desc: Item Magnet only pulls the items on your filter list (Magnet Filter... button), or everything but them.
minemenu.feature.mega_knockback.desc: Every mob you hit goes flying.
minemenu.feature.mind_control.desc: Look at a mob and press N: for 60 seconds it fights other hostile mobs for you. Works on bosses too.
minemenu.feature.minimap.desc: A map in the corner with your waypoints and nearby mobs. M opens the big map.
minemenu.feature.mob_aura.desc: Hostile mobs that come within 8 blocks of you die instantly.
minemenu.feature.mob_glow.desc: Every mob within 64 blocks glows, so you can see it through walls.
minemenu.feature.mob_health_bars.desc: Shows the health of mobs above their heads.
minemenu.feature.mob_swap.desc: Challenge: every 5 minutes you swap places with a random mob near you.
minemenu.feature.morph.desc: Look like a mob and get its powers (pick it with right-click). R uses the power, U turns you back.
minemenu.feature.night_vision.desc: See clearly in the dark and underwater.
minemenu.feature.no_fall_damage.desc: Falling never hurts, from any height.
minemenu.feature.noclip.desc: Fly through walls and the ground (spectator mode). Turn it off to get your normal game mode back where you are.
minemenu.feature.nuker.desc: Breaks every block around you (radius 3 by default), except the floor under your feet. Sneak to pause.
minemenu.feature.one_hit_kill.desc: Every hit you land does massive damage.
minemenu.feature.ore_vision.desc: Diamonds, gold, iron, emeralds, redstone, lapis and ancient debris within 20 blocks glow through walls.
minemenu.feature.peace_mode.desc: No new mobs spawn (the doMobSpawning game rule, restored when you turn it off).
minemenu.feature.phase.desc: Walk through doors, trapdoors, fence gates, glass, panes and iron bars without Noclip.
minemenu.feature.random_drops.desc: Challenge: every block you break drops a random item.
minemenu.feature.revenge.desc: If a mob kills you, lightning destroys it and you respawn right where you died.
minemenu.feature.scaffold.desc: Places blocks from your hotbar under your feet when you walk off an edge.
minemenu.feature.selection_wand.desc: Holding a wooden axe: left-click a block for corner 1, right-click for corner 2. Then copy, fill, clear...
minemenu.feature.slime_chunks.desc: Shows which chunks around you are slime chunks (green).
minemenu.feature.spider_climb.desc: Walk into a wall to climb straight up it, like a spider.
minemenu.feature.step_up.desc: Walk up full blocks without jumping, like stairs.
minemenu.feature.stun_hits.desc: Every mob you hit freezes in place for 10 seconds.
minemenu.feature.super_jump.desc: Jump really high. Fall damage is turned off while this is on.
minemenu.feature.tame_anything.desc: Right-click any mob with an empty hand to make it your pet: it follows you, never attacks you, and attacks what you attack.
minemenu.feature.terrain_brush.desc: Right-click with a golden shovel to sculpt the ground where you look (Brush... button picks the tool).
minemenu.feature.thor_mode.desc: Every mob you hit is struck by lightning (8 extra damage and fire; it never hurts you or burns the area).
minemenu.feature.thorns_aura.desc: Mobs that hit you take twice that damage back.
minemenu.feature.trident_storm.desc: A thrown trident calls lightning and a rain of tridents where it lands.
minemenu.feature.vein_miner.desc: Break one log or ore and the whole tree or vein comes down. Sneak to break just one block.
minemenu.feature.water_walk.desc: Walk on water and lava as if they were solid ground. Sneak to sink in.
minemenu.feature.zoom.desc: Hold Z to zoom in like a spyglass. Scroll while holding to zoom more or less. (Change the key in Controls.)
minemenu.feature_text.morph_mob: Mob (spider, bat, blaze, enderman, creeper, phantom...)
minemenu.form.head_chest_legs_feet_main_: Head, chest, legs, feet, main hand, off hand
minemenu.form.type_potion_splash_lingeri: Type: potion, splash, lingering or arrow
minemenu.menu.other_fps_counter: Another FPS counter is on. Turn it off first.
minemenu.picker.terrain_brush_right_clic: Terrain Brush: right-click with a golden shovel
minemenu.profiles.copied: Share code for %s copied to the clipboard
minemenu.profiles.no_code: The clipboard doesn't hold a MineMenu profile code (MMB1:...)
minemenu.safe_mode.caught: MineMenu: an error in %s was caught
minemenu.safe_mode.crash_loop: The game crashed while starting twice, so all hacks are off. Turn them back on in the menu.
minemenu.safe_mode.disabled: %s was disabled because of an error
minemenu.safe_mode.keeps_running: The game keeps running. Details in logs/latest.log
minemenu.safe_mode.title: MineMenu Safe Mode
minemenu.schematics.empty: No schematics yet: copy something (Build page), then "Save copy as...".
minemenu.schematics.title: Schematics
minemenu.screen.biome_painter.desc: Change the biome of the selection (like /fillbiome): grass, leaves, water colour, weather and mob spawns follow.
minemenu.screen.boss_arena.desc: Summon the Wither, the Ender Dragon, the Warden or an Elder Guardian, with more health and an arena.
minemenu.screen.brush.desc: Pick what the Terrain Brush does: flatten, raise, lower, smooth, paint, replace or drain.
minemenu.screen.delete_items.desc: Opens your inventory in delete mode: right-click any item to delete it.
minemenu.screen.find_structure.desc: Find the nearest village, stronghold, ancient city, temple... Its direction and distance show on screen.
minemenu.screen.give_item.desc: Pick any item and get it in your inventory, or dropped on the ground where you're looking.
minemenu.screen.give_xp.desc: Type a number of levels and get that much XP, e.g. 64.
minemenu.screen.item_creator.desc: Make any item: name with &colors, lore, any enchantment up to level 255, attributes, unbreakable, hidden tooltips.
minemenu.screen.loadouts.desc: Save sets of armor and weapons (up to 5) and switch between them with one click.
minemenu.screen.macros.desc: Record a few actions (day + clear weather + heal...) and put them on one key.
minemenu.screen.mob_creator.desc: Spawn a mob with equipment, effects, health, a name, as a baby, without AI, or with a rider (skeleton on a spider...).
minemenu.screen.potion_creator.desc: Make potions, splash/lingering potions or tipped arrows with any effects, levels and durations.
minemenu.screen.schematics.desc: Save the copy as a .nbt file (config/minemeboost/schematics) or load one to paste, in any world.
minemenu.screen.snapshots.desc: Save your whole inventory (up to 5 per world) and get it back later.
minemenu.screen.spawn_mob.desc: Pick any mob and spawn it where you're looking, or customize it first.
minemenu.screen.structures.desc: Place a ready-made build where you look: house, tower, castle, bridge, farm, Nether portal, or a real village, temple...
minemenu.screen.time_weather.desc: Set the exact time, how fast days go by (or stop time), and sun, rain or thunder.
minemenu.screen.waypoints.desc: Up to 10 named waypoints for this world: save, teleport, and see their direction and distance on screen.
minemenu.structures.cant_place: That structure can't be placed here
minemenu.structures.not_loaded: Part of that area is not loaded; come closer
minemenu.structures.placed: Placed %s (%s blocks changed, Undo takes it back)
minemenu.text.add_this_many_levels_on_to: Add this many levels on top of what you have.
minemenu.text.all_10_waypoints_are_used_: All 10 waypoints are used: delete one in Waypoints... first
minemenu.text.all_minemenu_and_mineboost: All MineMenu and MineBoost settings, keys, profiles and macros go back to the defaults. A backup of the config files is made first (config/minemeboost/backup-...).
minemenu.text.armor_and_the_items_in_you: Armor and the items in your hands. Saved with this world.
minemenu.text.biome_set_to_s_s_pieces: Biome set to %s (%s pieces). Leave and come back if colours look old.
minemenu.text.cheats_only_work_in_single: Cheats only work in singleplayer (and your own LAN world).
Cheats only work in singleplayer. Info HUD, Minimap and Chunk Borders still work here.
minemenu.text.chest_marked_open_marked_c: Chest marked. Open Marked Chest opens it from anywhere.
minemenu.text.click_then_press_the_key_y: Click, then press the key you want (Esc or Backspace = no key). Works when no menu is open.
minemenu.text.click_to_cycle_normal_gian: Click to cycle: Normal, Giant (4x) and Tiny (1/4).
minemenu.text.command_palette_run_anythi: Command Palette: run anything by typing its name.
minemenu.text.copied_s_blocks_paste_prev: Copied %s blocks. Paste (preview) shows where it goes.
minemenu.text.copy_something_first_or_lo: Copy something first (or load a schematic)
minemenu.text.delete_mode_right_click_an: DELETE MODE: right-click an item to delete it
minemenu.text.drag_to_set_the_exact_time: Drag to set the exact time of day. (Always Day overrides this.)
minemenu.text.favorites_right_click_any_: Favorites: right-click any button and star it to put it here.
minemenu.text.give_back_the_last_item_yo: Give back the last item you deleted.
minemenu.text.give_the_selected_item_ent: Give the selected item. Enter or double-clicking an item works too.
minemenu.text.hold_an_item_to_enchant_it: Hold an item to enchant it
minemenu.text.hold_the_block_to_fill_wit: Hold the block to fill with in your main hand
minemenu.text.hold_the_block_to_paint_wi: Hold the block to paint with in your off hand
minemenu.text.hold_the_new_block_in_your: Hold the new block in your off hand; the block you look at is replaced
minemenu.text.how_fast_the_sun_moves_nor: How fast the sun moves. Normal is a 20 minute day. Goes back to Normal when you leave the world.
minemenu.text.how_many_1_16_32_or: How many: 1, 16, 32 or 64. Items that don't stack (tools, armor) always come one at a time.
minemenu.text.how_many_to_spawn_at_once: How many to spawn at once: 1, 5 or 10.
minemenu.text.inventory_full_s_dropped_a: Inventory full: %s dropped at your feet
minemenu.text.inventory_straight_into_yo: Inventory: straight into your inventory (if it's full, the rest drops at your feet). Ground: dropped on the block you're looking at.
minemenu.text.look_at_a_block_to_spawn: Look at a block to spawn a mob there
minemenu.text.look_at_a_block_to_telepor: Look at a block to teleport to it
minemenu.text.look_at_a_chest_or_barrel: Look at a chest or barrel (within 8 blocks)
minemenu.text.look_at_a_mob_then_press: Look at a mob, then press the Mind Control key
minemenu.text.look_at_a_mob_to_resize: Look at a mob to resize it
minemenu.text.look_at_a_mob_to_ride: Look at a mob to ride it
minemenu.text.look_at_the_ground_where_i: Look at the ground where it should go
minemenu.text.look_where_it_should_go_th: Look where it should go, then Confirm Paste. Rotate / Mirror work while previewing.
minemenu.text.map_s_blocks_per_pixel_scr: Map (%s blocks per pixel). Scroll: zoom, drag: move. %s
minemenu.text.mark_a_chest_in_this_dimen: Mark a chest in this dimension first
minemenu.text.mob_war_s_mobs_are_fightin: Mob War! %s mobs are fighting each other
minemenu.text.morph_s_isn_t_a_mob: Morph: "%s" isn't a mob. Right-click Morph to pick one.
minemenu.text.name: Name
minemenu.text.need_at_least_2_hostile_mo: Need at least 2 hostile mobs nearby
minemenu.text.no_empty_structure_chests_: No empty structure chests nearby (it only refills chests in villages, temples, mineshafts...)
minemenu.text.no_home_yet_use_set_home: No home yet: use Set Home first
minemenu.text.no_more_enchantments_fit_o: No more enchantments fit on this item
minemenu.text.no_s_found_in_this_dimensi: No %s found in this dimension (searched about 1600 blocks)
minemenu.text.revenge_the_s_that_killed_: ⚡ Revenge! The %s that killed you has been destroyed.
minemenu.text.riding_a_s_sneak_to_get: Riding a %s! Sneak to get off
minemenu.text.s_chest_s_will_have_new: %s chest%s will have new loot when you open them
minemenu.text.s_disappears_right_away_on: %s disappears right away on Peaceful. Change the difficulty to see it.
minemenu.text.s_found_at_s_s_s: %s found at %s, %s (%s blocks away). Follow the arrow in your HUD.
minemenu.text.s_is_under_your_control_fo: %s is under your control for 60 seconds
minemenu.text.save_where_you_re_standing: Save where you're standing (and the way you're facing).
minemenu.text.saved_with_this_world_set_: Saved with this world. Set Home / Go Home use the one called "Home".
minemenu.text.search_an_item_or_a_catego: Search an item or a category: comida, armadura, ferramentas...
minemenu.text.searches_your_dimension_li: Searches your dimension, like /locate. The result shows in your HUD.
minemenu.text.set_both_corners_first_cor: Set both corners first (Corner 1 / Corner 2, or the Selection Wand)
minemenu.text.settings_theme_profiles_ex: Settings: theme, profiles (export/import), key conflicts, reset, what's new.
minemenu.text.show_the_direction_and_dis: Show the direction and distance to this waypoint on your screen.
minemenu.text.show_the_list_of_active_ch: Show the list of active cheats in the top-left corner.
minemenu.text.show_your_frames_per_secon: Show your frames per second in the top-left corner.
minemenu.text.small_slide_in_when_menus_: Small slide-in when menus open. Always off with the Toaster and Potato presets.
minemenu.text.spawn_on_the_block_you_re: Spawn on the block you're looking at. Double-clicking a mob works too.
minemenu.text.spawned_s_but_mob_aura_is: Spawned %s, but Mob Aura is on, so it won't last long!
minemenu.text.start_the_preview_first_pa: Start the preview first (Paste), and look at a block
minemenu.text.steps_action_day_feature_f: Steps: action:DAY, feature:FLY, cmd:time set noon, wait:20 (ticks), screen:waypoints...
minemenu.text.still_building_try_again_i: Still building, try again in a moment
minemenu.text.summoned_16_blocks_in_fron: Summoned 16 blocks in front of you. God Mode recommended.
minemenu.text.that_dimension_doesn_t_exi: That dimension doesn't exist any more
minemenu.text.the_ender_dragon_can_t_be: The Ender Dragon can't be mind-controlled
minemenu.text.the_marked_chest_s_chunk_i: The marked chest's chunk isn't loaded (too far away)
minemenu.text.the_selection_is_too_big_s: The selection is too big (%s blocks, max %s)
minemenu.text.then_use_hacks_and_actions: Then use hacks and actions from the menu, keys or the Command Palette. Come back here and press Stop.
minemenu.text.this_mob_has_no_power_to: This mob has no power to use. Try blaze, ghast, enderman or creeper.
minemenu.text.tip_turn_on_god_mode_fly: Tip: turn on God Mode, Fly or Super Jump before you land!
minemenu.text.turn_every_on_off_hack_on: Turn every ON/OFF hack on at once (on every page). Click again to turn them all off. Noclip, Freecam, Morph, the Nuker, the build tools and the Fun challenges aren't included.
minemenu.text.type_a_hack_action_preset_: Type a hack, action, preset or waypoint...
minemenu.text.you_have_s_levels_how_many: You have %s levels. How many do you want?
minemenu.text.you_haven_t_died_in_this: You haven't died in this world yet
minemenu.text.you_haven_t_died_in_this_2: You haven't died in this world yet.
minemenu.text.your_items_are_in_a_death: Your items are in a Death Chest at %s, %s, %s (see your waypoints)
minemenu.text.your_level_becomes_exactly: Your level becomes exactly this number. Enter does this too.
minemenu.text.your_whole_inventory_resto: Your whole inventory. Restoring replaces what you carry now. Saved with this world.
minemenu.whats_new.build: §eBuild: §fa schematics browser with previews (from above and from the front), rename and delete; and Undo now also works on vanilla structures (villages, temples, igloos...).
minemenu.whats_new.fps: §aFPS: §fRender Scale now sharpens the picture (CAS), so 75% looks almost like 100%. Impostors: far mobs as a flat picture (A/B-tested). The low presets pick the Render Scale your own A/B test measured.
minemenu.whats_new.language: §bLanguage: §fevery text can be translated; Portuguese (Portugal) is included. Pick it in Options → Language.
minemenu.whats_new.tests: §7Behind the scenes: an in-game test suite and a long soak test that run automatically.
minemenu.whats_new.title: §dMineMeBoost 3.5.0
